class.name: IfcWorkControl
class.brief_description: An IfcWorkControl is an abstract supertype which captures information that is common to both IfcWorkPlan and IfcWorkSchedule . HISTORY New class in IFC 2x CHANGE IFC2x4 Corrected assignment of resources to work control in documentation. Assignment of tasks to work control updated based on changes of task time definitions and the introduction of a summary task. Identifier has been renamed (now Iden

members.member: The date that the plan is created. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
The authors of the work plan. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
A description of the purpose of the work schedule. A String, or null when unset.
The total duration of the entire work schedule. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a float in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
The total time float of the entire work schedule. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a float in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
The start time of the schedule. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
The finish time of the schedule. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
